GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 015 (27 Jun 47) LS-L
(SCAPIN-1740)
APO 500
27 June 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Amendment to Exercise of Criminal Jurisdiction
1. Delete paragraph 2c of Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, AG 015 (19 Feb 46) LS, subject: “Exercise of Criminal Jurisdiction,” dated 19 February 1946, (SCAPIN 756), as amended on 19 September 1946, (SCAPIN 1218).
2. The possession, taking, receipt, or disposal of property of the Occupation Forces or any member thereof, or of any person attached to or accompanying such forces, is prohibited, unless duly authorized.
3. Violations of paragraph 2 above will be prosecuted pursuant to the provisions of Imperial Ordinance No. 311, 11 June 1946.
4. Any provision of law in conflict with the contents of this Memorandum will be amended to conform therewith.
5. Monthly reports on the cases tried under Imperial Ordinance 311 will be submitted to this Headquarters, through local military government units, indicating, in each case, the location of courts, docket number, gist of offense, number of accused, pleas, sentence if found guilty remarks deemed appropriate.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R. M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
